rationale: Builds on the best reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact structural change instead of another scalar sweep. The tail anchor is no longer frozen through the whole reverse recurrence pass: after each deeper recurrent block, it is partially refreshed toward the new hidden state using a gain-scaled fixed refresh. This spends no extra learned bytes, keeps shapes compile-stable, preserves the current quant-aware/export path, and directly targets the local signal that nearby anchor-refresh variants were promising while avoiding the heavier learned-gate versions that recently regressed.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor Drift Refresh
